logic.top_level: pathways (III.A standalone; III.B with abdominal procedures; III.C wound-healing; III.D renal transplant; III.E other body areas) plus conjunctive restrictions IV

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Panniculectomy performed in conjunction with abdominal or gynecological procedures (such as hysterectomy, obesity surgery, including hernia repair that are reducible and have associated symptoms) is considered medically necessary if all the criteria for performing panniculectomy (III A.) have been met or there is persistent documented infection which cannot be resolved with medical treatments
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Garbled parenthetical; whether 'or persistent infection' alone suffices without III.A.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: In addition to the Section III criteria, obese patients (BMI greater than 35) must receive nutrition education for 3 or more months
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Restriction applies to III.A only or also III.E?

requirement_kinds.quote: Pannus is Grade II or above as documented by clinical notes and/or pre-operative notes

unresponsive and refractory to three or more months of medical treatment. Medical treatment should consist of good hygiene practices, topical antifungals, topical and/or systemic corticosteroids, and local and/or systemic antibiotics
Pannus interferes with activities of daily living

obese patients (BMI greater than 35) must receive nutrition education for 3 or more months ... attendance of professional nutrition class ... two or more individual professional nutrition counseling sessions
panniculectomy should not be performed until eighteen (18) months post bariatric surgery and when the weight loss has been stable for the most recent six (6) months
Select patients undergoing renal transplant whose large pannus creates a very high risk for wound complications
A Kaiser Permanente-participating physician must order imaging and testing necessary to establish a diagnosis

thresholds.quote: 3 or more months ... two or more individual professional nutrition counseling sessions
